title: Chapter 3 · AI Mock 3
instructions: Original AI-authored challenging practice inspired by topics and style in the available teacher quizzes. Not a teacher paper or official mark scheme. Work independently under timed conditions; self-mark against the model points after submission.
description: Timed teacher-inspired mock with written answers and model marking points.

questions.text: Explain the function of an actuator in a computer-controlled system.

answer.text: Causes a physical action such as moving a motor or valve

questions.text: Explain why cache is faster to access than secondary storage and how it is used.

answer.text: Cache is small fast memory close to the CPU
Frequently used data/instructions are kept there to reduce slower accesses

questions.text: Give two advantages and one disadvantage of a laser printer for an office.

answer.text: Initial cost or toner cost can be high

questions.text: Describe how a computer can output an analogue signal.

answer.text: Digital values are sent to a DAC
The DAC converts them to an analogue signal
The signal can drive a device such as a speaker through suitable amplification
